page: Amazon Web Services r5d.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by the AWS Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture with an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor operating at 3.1 GHz. The configuration provides 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, supported by a 35 MB L3 cache. Memory capacity stands at 128.0 GB of DDR4 RAM running at 3 GHz, yielding 8.0 GB of memory per physical core.

This instance includes 600 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, providing direct-attached high-speed instance store volumes. Network performance is characterized by a baseline bandwidth of 5 Gbps. There are no GPUs bundled with this instance type.

Benchmark data indicates that single-core CPU performance, including stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, falls into the bottom 25% category. However, multi-core CPU performance, memory bandwidth, and database operations like Redis SET run in the middle 50% average tier. This hardware profile is suited for memory-intensive workloads, caching layers, and database applications that benefit from local NVMe storage, though it exhibits lower single-threaded processing efficiency.
